title: Backy

description.en: A dependable home for AI-agent backups. Store, inspect, and restore with confidence.
description.zh: 给 AI 智能体的备份服务，集中接收、存储、预览和恢复数据。

subject: Small olive tortoise with one folded multicolored leaf on its shell

source.description: AI backup service for receiving, storing, previewing, and restoring backups

subject.en: Small olive tortoise with one folded multicolored leaf on its shell
subject.zh: 橄榄色小陆龟，龟壳上托着一片折叠的多彩叶子

title.en: A leaf along for the ride

description.en: A compact tortoise pauses during a slow step and turns toward the viewer. A domed shell, short neck and natural feet give it a clear whole-animal silhouette.
description.zh: 紧凑的小陆龟在缓慢迈步时停下，转头看向镜头。圆拱龟壳、短颈和自然脚掌形成清晰的全身轮廓。

title.zh: 橄榄色盾片与一片叶子

description.en: Broad olive and ochre facets describe the shell without noisy scales. One folded coral, teal and violet leaf rises above the shell as the only colorful accessory.
description.zh: 宽阔橄榄绿和赭黄色面描绘龟壳，避免琐碎鳞片。一片珊瑚、青与紫色的折叶从壳边升起，成为唯一的彩色装饰。

description.en: Unequal broad scute impressions cross a deep sage field. Interrupted seams and soft contact shadows echo the shell with room to breathe.
description.zh: 大小不一的宽阔盾片压纹铺过深鼠尾草色底纹，断开的接缝与浅接触阴影呼应龟壳，并保留充分留白。

palette.source: Selected Backy presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: The complete animal and accessory have at least 275.5 px clearance from the actual rounded outline. Ten export sizes preserve one uniform placement. Small app/browser marks use the transparent foreground; fine facets and accessory details simplify at 16 px.
sizeNote.zh: 完整动物和兴趣点距离真实圆角轮廓至少 275.5 px。十种导出尺寸保持同一组等比位置，小型 UI 与浏览器使用透明主体；细小切面和装饰细节在 16 px 时会简化。

goal.en: Collect application backups, inspect content and history by project, and retrieve original files.
goal.zh: 集中接收应用备份，按项目查看内容、追踪记录，并取回原始文件。

role.en: Shared types, API logic and scripts
role.zh: 共享类型、API 逻辑与脚本
工作区依赖与本地工具
管理界面开发与静态构建

role.en: API, scheduled jobs and static assets

role.zh: 项目、备份元数据与日志
签名 URL 与对象复制

description.en: Unequal shell plates and interrupted seams form a sheltered rhythm around the small tortoise.
description.zh: 大小不同的龟甲轮廓与断续接缝，围绕小陆龟形成稳妥、舒缓的节奏。

alt.en: Small olive tortoise with one folded multicolored leaf on its shell on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 橄榄色小陆龟，龟壳上托着一片折叠的多彩叶子，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.en: A safe place to return to.

description.en: Small olive tortoise with one folded multicolored leaf on its shell.
description.zh: 橄榄色小陆龟，龟壳上托着一片折叠的多彩叶子。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥63px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 63px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
